format: Studio / Custom events: judging panel readiness and recovery
requirement: DanceFlow policy (not a body rule): the Studio ballot lock needs at least three present, eligible judges and an odd panel for ordinal_majority and callback_tally (at least one for proficiency_rating); panel readiness shown to organizers and enforced at round start must agree with that rule and with the scoring engines, and a panel that cannot progress must not display READY. Safeguards are never weakened to make readiness pass.

implementation.symbol_or_migration: competition_round_panel_status (readiness: default minimum 1, no parity or scoring-method rule)
X-3 panel check (odd and at least 3)

enforcement_point: Database: E1 competition_round_panel_status consumed by O1 start_competition_round; E2 lock; engines. Correction is designed, not built.
interpretation_notes: INCONSISTENT and a mandatory Studio/Custom release blocker (owner R-10 part 3): readiness accepts 1, 2 or an even panel and any unsupported scoring method, ignores absence, and silently falls back to a minimum of 1; the lock and engines refuse those panels. Design only; DEV and PROD currently hold no misleading or stuck round (read-only counts 2026-11-24). Closes only when corrected AND independently verified.
decision_refs: R-10 (owner decision 2026-11-23: parts 1-2 ratified; part 3 mandatory Studio/Custom release blocker, open)
